table.name: Fires
table.purpose: Wildfire occurrence records for the United States, 1992-2015 (matches the USGS/Kaggle '1.88M US Wildfires' Short-2 dataset). Each row is one wildfire incident with discovery and containment dates, cause, size, location and administrative jurisdiction.

col_002.name: discovery_date
col_002.description: Date the fire was discovered, as a Julian day number (days since 4713 BC, .5 = noon UTC); range 2448622.5-2457387.5 corresponds to 1992-2015.

col_003.name: discovery_doy
col_003.description: Day of year (1-366) on which the fire was discovered.

col_004.name: discovery_time
col_004.description: Time of discovery as HHMM (0000-2359); empty string when unknown (~47%).

col_005.name: stat_cause_code
col_005.description: Statistical cause of the fire, numeric code 1-13 (e.g. 1=Lightning, 5=Debris Burning, 7=Arson, 9=Miscellaneous, 13=Missing/Undefined); pairs with col_006.

col_006.name: stat_cause_descr
col_006.description: Statistical cause description (Lightning, Debris Burning, Arson, Miscellaneous, Missing/Undefined, Campfire, Children, Fireworks, etc.).

col_007.name: cont_date
col_007.description: Date the fire was contained, as a Julian day number; empty string when unknown (~47%).

col_008.name: cont_doy
col_008.description: Day of year (1-366) on which the fire was contained; empty when unknown.

col_009.name: cont_time
col_009.description: Time of containment as HHMM (0000-2359); empty when unknown (~52%).

col_010.name: fire_size
col_010.description: Final size of the fire in acres (0 to ~606,945; median 1 acre).

col_012.name: latitude
col_012.description: Latitude of the fire point location in decimal degrees (17.9-70.3, i.e. US including Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico).

col_013.name: longitude
col_013.description: Longitude of the fire point location in decimal degrees (negative, -178.8 to -65.3).

col_014.name: owner_code
col_014.description: Numeric code (0-15) for the land owner/jurisdiction where the fire started; pairs with col_015 (e.g. 14=Missing/Not Specified, 8=Private, 5=USFS, 2=BIA, 13=State or Private).

col_015.name: owner_descr
col_015.description: Land ownership description: MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED, PRIVATE, USFS, BIA, STATE OR PRIVATE, BLM, COUNTY, OTHER FEDERAL, etc.

col_016.name: state
col_016.description: Two-letter US state/territory postal code where the fire occurred (CA, GA, TX, NC, FL, ..., PR).

col_017.name: county
col_017.description: County of the fire: inconsistently populated with county names (Lincoln, Polk, ...) or county FIPS codes ('5', '51', '91'); empty for ~36% of rows.

col_018.name: fips_code
col_018.description: Three-digit county FIPS code within the state (001-810); empty for ~36% of rows.

col_019.name: fips_name
col_019.description: County name from the FIPS lookup (Washington, Lincoln, Jackson, Mono, Howell, Botetourt, ...); empty for ~36% of rows.
